ModMetaData.name: RimMT Diagnostics v0.18 - T34B Scanner Parallel
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Optional diagnostics companion for RimMT T34-B. Adds external measurement of the general scanner parallel fabric, same-package/cross-package worker plan hits, worker build time, main-thread live-check cost, persistent fabric batching and scheduler utilization. Disable this companion for pure production feel tests.
